{

    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK after testing; suggested using BasicTestingSetup for the unit test"
    },
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "ACK; explained mempool readiness states and why hiding the distinction is useful"
    },
    {
      "login": "enirox001",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; asked whether production paths ever run without a mempool"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested redefining the contract instead of changing code, and asked if users had reported issues"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3916565441",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "use BasicTestingSetup for the test case so MinerTestingSetup is not built unnecessarily",
      "quote": "the suite's `MinerTestingSetup` still gets built around it with nothing using it",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author switched to BasicTestingSetup and rebased in rc:3919651258",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3919651258"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3919651258",
      "status_by_quote": "Nice, I switched to `BasicTestingSetup`, rebased, thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5586736218",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Is there a current production path where lookups run without the mempool, or is this primarily keeping interface contracts consistent for internal callers and tests?",
      "quote": "is there a current production path where these lookups run without the mempool, given that IPC `makeMining()` waits for the chainstate to load?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Sjors agreed it likely cannot happen, and author confirmed IPC callers cannot hit it",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5979544252"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5618763836"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5979544252",
      "status_by_quote": "Current IPC callers can't hit this. I changed it because it contradicts the documented contract, rather than in response to a user report."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5619676450",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "redefine the contract to specify that returning fewer elements than requested is an error, leaving the code as is",
      "quote": "wouldn't be it easier to just _change the contract_, and specify that \"a returned vector that has less elements than IDs requested should be treated as error\"? This would not mean any extra work for the callers. The code could stay as it is.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "Sjors explained that hiding the distinction between mempool readiness states is cleaner for callers",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5979544252"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:5620913593"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5620913593",
      "status_by_quote": "The difference between (1) and (2) is not interesting to the client, the previous code requires clients to distinguish them, this PR hides the distinction."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5619676450",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "Is there any report of this causing a problem for users?",
      "quote": "Is there any report of this causing a problem with users?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author confirmed the change was made to fix contract contradiction rather than from a user report",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5979544252"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5979544252",
      "status_by_quote": "Current IPC callers can't hit this. I changed it because it contradicts the documented contract, rather than in response to a user report."
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5092607794",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "built and ran the unit tests, and verified that reverting interfaces.cpp makes the new test fail",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": [
        "interfaces.cpp"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5539221048",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "prefers the simpler approach of returning nullptrs over throwing when there is no mempool, which would also require handling the mempool disk-load state",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5586736218",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "returning a list of nullptrs better maintains the documented contract of returning an entry per requested ID than returning nothing",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "re-review following author's clarification on IPC callers and user reports",
      "id": "c:5979544252"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Reclassified schema 1 objections as suggestions, added questions from enirox001 and optout21, and marked them answered following Sjors's explanation and the author's reply in c:5979544252."
}
